entities.name: Financial creditors (banks, NBFCs, bondholders)
entities.profile: Lenders that start or vote in insolvency processes and enforce guarantees.

entities.name: NBFCs and HFCs as debtors
entities.profile: Notified financial service providers whose insolvency runs under the FSP Rules on RBI's application.

entities.name: Corporate debtors and promoters
entities.profile: Companies and LLPs in, or facing, insolvency, and their directors and promoters.

entities.name: Resolution applicants and bidders
entities.profile: Investors submitting resolution plans or buying assets in liquidation.

entities.name: Insolvency professionals and valuers
entities.profile: IRPs, RPs, liquidators, Administrators, registered valuers and their agencies.

updates.title: New Chairperson takes charge at IBBI
changes: A new Chairperson took charge of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India on 26-11-2026.
A new ex-officio member was notified on 04-11-2026.

updates.title: Disciplinary orders: three insolvency professionals suspended for two years each
updates.applies: Insolvency professionals; creditors' committees that appoint them.
changes: The IBBI Disciplinary Committee suspended the registration of three insolvency professionals for two years each, by orders of 03-11-2026, 12-11-2026 and 13-11-2026.
A suspended professional cannot continue existing assignments (section 206), so the creditors must replace them.
A fourth order of 09-11-2026 concerned the conduct of a liquidation, including valuation and a scheme placed without secured creditors' consent.

creditor.text: Check whether a suspended professional is acting in any of your cases and move for a replacement.

ip.text: The orders show the conduct IBBI penalises.

actions: Creditors: check current resolution professionals and liquidators against IBBI's orders page.

updates.title: Real estate CIRPs: RERA compliance, RERA's views on plans and site notices
updates.applies: IRPs and RPs of corporate debtors with real estate projects, CoCs and prospective resolution applicants.
changes: RPs must comply with RERA during the CIRP.
RPs may invite RERA's written views on plans and share them with the CoC and bidders.
The CIRP must be shown on signboards at each project site and office within 7 days of appointment.

ip.text: New site disclosure and RERA steps in every real estate CIRP.

creditor.text: CoC gets the regulator's view on plan feasibility.

applicant.text: Plans may be tested against RERA's views.

actions: Add RERA portal checks and site notices to real estate CIRP checklists.

updates.title: Revised Form CA with a separate part for homebuyers
updates.applies: Financial creditors in a class, including real estate allottees, and IRPs and RPs.
changes: Form CA has Part I for other creditors in a class and Part II for allottees.
Claims filed earlier need not be refiled.

ip.text: Use the new form for claims received from 30-10-2026.

creditor.text: Creditors in a class file in Part I.

updates.title: CIRP Regulations amended (fifth amendment of 2026)
updates.ref: IBBI (Insolvency Resolution Process for Corporate Persons) (Fifth Amendment) Regulations, 2026
changes: The CIRP Regulations were amended again; the consolidated text as on 30-10-2026 is the current version.

ip.text: Check the consolidated text for changed steps.

actions: Read the consolidated CIRP Regulations as on 30-10-2026.

updates.title: Liquidator may modify the list of stakeholders and tells the NCLT within 30 days
changes: The liquidator may modify an entry in the list of stakeholders on new information and informs the NCLT within 30 days.

creditor.text: Admitted amounts can change on new information.

actions: Keep a log of changes to the stakeholder list.

updates.title: No interim moratorium for personal guarantors, even in pending applications
updates.applies: Creditors of personal guarantors, resolution professionals and guarantors.
changes: IBBI drew attention to Bombay and Delhi High Court rulings that the 2026 amendment ended the interim moratorium for personal guarantors from 26-05-2026, including for applications pending then.

creditor.text: Recovery suits and enforcement against personal guarantors can proceed.

ip.text: Interim moratorium can no longer be relied on in PG cases.

updates.title: Discussion paper on safeguards in personal guarantor insolvency
updates.applies: Proposal for comment only; not in force.
changes: IBBI invited comments on proposed changes. Nothing changes until regulations are notified.

updates.title: IPs to watch for misuse of insolvency and apply to the NCLT
updates.applies: Insolvency professionals; creditors and debtors in CIRPs and liquidations.
changes: IBBI listed signs of misuse, such as a single non-bank creditor dominating the CoC, clusters of connected companies and very low recoveries without proper valuation.
An IP who believes on reasonable grounds that a process is fraudulent or malicious must apply to the NCLT.

creditor.text: Assigned-debt and single-creditor cases will face more scrutiny.

debtor.text: Processes used to evade liabilities may be challenged.

actions: Build the indicators into case intake reviews.

updates.title: Discussion paper on guidance for spotting fraudulent or malicious CIRPs and recourse under ss. 60(5) and 65
updates.applies: Proposal for comment only; not in force.
changes: IBBI invited comments on proposed changes. Nothing changes until regulations are notified.

updates.title: Discussion paper on amendments to the CIRP, Liquidation and personal guarantor regulations
updates.applies: Proposal for comment only; not in force.
changes: IBBI invited comments on proposed changes. Nothing changes until regulations are notified.

updates.title: Guidelines and format for valuation reports under the Code
changes: Valuers prepare reports and keep documents in the format IBBI notified.

ip.text: Check valuation reports against the format.

actions: Share the format with appointed valuers.

updates.title: Observers in CoCs dominated by non-bank creditors
updates.applies: CoCs where creditors other than scheduled banks and public financial institutions hold over 66% of the vote.
changes: The RP invites the five largest unrelated operational creditors, including the three largest statutory authorities, as non-voting observers and minutes their views.
Only unrelated operational creditors count for a CoC made only of operational creditors.

creditor.text: Non-bank-led CoCs will have observers in the room.

actions: Check CoC composition against the 66% test.

updates.title: IBBI regulations aligned with the 2026 Code amendments
changes: Liquidation to finish within 180 days; secured creditors decide within 14 days; claims verified within 7 days; distribution within 15 days.
CIRP claims admitted or rejected with reasons within 7 days; more information required with s. 9 and s. 10 applications.
Forms are now notified by IBBI circular (formats circulars of 02-06-2026 and 03-06-2026).

creditor.text: Shorter liquidation timelines and the 14-day security decision.

actions: Secured creditors: decide on relinquishment within 14 days of liquidation.

updates.title: IBC (Amendment) Act, 2026 in force (except CIIRP and group insolvency)
updates.applies: Everyone dealing with processes under the Code.
changes: Admission of a financial creditor's application is mandatory once default is shown; an IU record of default suffices for a financial institution.
Withdrawal needs 90% of the CoC and is barred after the first invitation for plans.
CoC supervises liquidation; CIRP can be restored for up to 120 days; dissolution without liquidation.
Government dues are not treated as secured in the waterfall.
No interim moratorium for personal guarantors.
New penalties for frivolous proceedings and breach of moratorium or plan.

creditor.text: Faster admission; secured creditor rights redefined.

fsp.text: FSP Rules unchanged; general CIRP changes apply through them.

actions: Review pending applications and liquidation strategies against the new provisions.

updates.title: International Valuation Standards apply to valuations under the Code
updates.applies: Registered valuers, IPs and all valuations under the Code.
changes: IBBI notified the IVSC's International Valuation Standards for all valuations under the Code.

creditor.text: More comparable fair and liquidation values.

updates.title: Beneficial ownership statement and s. 32A affidavit in every resolution plan
changes: Formats for the beneficial ownership statement and s. 32A eligibility affidavit required by reg 38(3A).

applicant.text: Disclose the full ownership chain to natural persons.

ip.text: Check the statement is in the plan.
